# Revideo patches (patch-package)

Revideo 0.10.4 needs three small fixes, proven in the original PoC. They are applied
via `patch-package` on `postinstall` (see `../package.json`). This directory holds
the `.patch` files.

**Foundation status (#742 / T2):** the patch *files* are generated by running
`npx patch-package @revideo/<pkg>` **after** `npm install` on the target OS — they
diff against the installed tree, so they cannot be committed before the first
install. The three fixes to reproduce are documented here; T2 runs the install once
in CI, applies the edits, and commits the resulting `patches/*.patch`.

## The three fixes

1. **`@revideo/renderer` — strip hardcoded `--single-process`.**
   `lib/server/render-video.js` pushes `--single-process`, which crashes Chrome on
   some hosts. Remove/parametrise it. (`render.ts` also filters the flag defensively
   from `puppeteer.launch`, so this is belt-and-braces.)

2. **`@revideo/renderer` — absolute-outFile temp-folder name.**
   Revideo builds its temp folder as `revideo-<outFile>-<uuid>`; an absolute path in
   `outFile` produces an invalid folder name. `render.ts` already works around this by
   passing only the basename in `settings.outFile` and the dir in `settings.outDir`.

3. **`@revideo/ffmpeg` — configurable public folder for audio assets.**
   `dist/utils.js` `resolvePath` hardcodes `path.join(output, '../public', assetPath)`,
   so audio MP3s only resolve when `outDir` is a sibling of `./public`. See the PoC's
   `AUDIO-FIX-REPORT.md`. Either patch `resolvePath` to accept a configurable public
   dir, or keep the `render.ts` convention (outDir sibling of `public/`).

## Upstreaming

These are candidates for upstream PRs to https://github.com/redotvideo/revideo.
Until then, `patch-package` keeps them surviving a fresh `npm ci`.
